h:
使用 AuraSR 的平铺扩散工作流程。

这需要标准 SDXL 大小的输入。任何更大的东西都会占用大量的显存。

此工作流程是围绕 sdxl lighting 设计的，模型如下：https://civitai.com/models/321390/mjolnir-sdxl-lightning

SDXL Controlnet 磁贴来自此处：https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-tile-sdxl-1.0/tree/main

face_yolov8n-seg2_60.pt 来自此处：https://huggingface.co/jags/yolov8_model_segmentation-set/tree/main

这使用了以下可能不在管理器上的存储库和/或模型：

https://github.com/GreenLandisaLie/AuraSR-ComfyUI

一切都在管理器的最新节点上。

享受

o.en:
A tiled diffusion workflow using AuraSR.

This takes standard SDXL sized inputs. anything larger will take very large amounts of vram.

This workflow was designed around sdxl lightning with this model:https://civitai.com/models/321390/mjolnir-sdxl-lightning

SDXL Controlnet tile from here:https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-tile-sdxl-1.0/tree/main

face_yolov8n-seg2_60.pt from here:https://huggingface.co/jags/yolov8_model_segmentation-set/tree/main

This uses the following repos and/or models that may not be on manager:

https://github.com/GreenLandisaLie/AuraSR-ComfyUI

Everything is on the newest nodes from manager.

Enjoy
